scientific_limitations: The theorem addresses rational hyperflex points on geometrically smooth plane quartics over F2, not ordinary flexes, geometric Weierstrass points, or fields of larger order; possible unindexed historical equivalences remain. The article by Viana and Paz La Torre was accessed at abstract level only.
title: Three rational hyperflexes characterize one projective orbit of binary plane quartics
